Annual exchange rates, local currency per US dollar

Source: R/currency-data.R
currency_fx.Rd

One rate per currency and year, the annual average. The column is named lcu_per_usd rather than anything shorter because the direction is the easiest thing to invert by accident: convert_data's coefficients are US dollars per unit, the reciprocal of what is stored here.

Usage

currency_fx

Format

A data frame of one row per currency and year:

code

ISO 4217 currency code

year

calendar year

lcu_per_usd

units of the currency per US dollar, annual average

source

the series the value came from, "numeraire" for the US dollar's own rows, which are 1 by definition rather than by measurement, or "user" for a row from add_currency_fx()

Source

World Bank World Development Indicators, series PA.NUS.FCRF (official exchange rate, LCU per US$, period average), which credits IMF International Financial Statistics as its own source. Licensed CC BY 4.0, https://datacatalog.worldbank.org/public-licenses.

Details

Rates are keyed by currency, not by country. Members of a currency union report the same rate, so one row serves them all. USD is the numeraire and is 1 by construction. The euro begins in 1999; a year before that has no euro rate because there was no euro.

attr(currency_fx, "base_year") is the year untagged money is read at – the latest year the table covers for a quorum of currencies, and the year convert_data$base$Currency is generated from. currency_base_year() reads it, or sets it elsewhere.

The table stops at the year it was built from. add_currency_fx() adds a row, or replaces one, for the current session.

See also

currency_codes, currency_deflator

Examples

attr(currency_fx, "base_year")
#> [1] 2025
subset(currency_fx, code == "EUR" & year >= 2020)
#>      code year lcu_per_usd      source
#> 2351  EUR 2020   0.8755064 PA.NUS.FCRF
#> 2352  EUR 2021   0.8454941 PA.NUS.FCRF
#> 2353  EUR 2022   0.9496238 PA.NUS.FCRF
#> 2354  EUR 2023   0.9248396 PA.NUS.FCRF
#> 2355  EUR 2024   0.9238895 PA.NUS.FCRF
#> 2356  EUR 2025   0.8849690 PA.NUS.FCRF
